periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the black eye patches are oriented diagonally at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The patches are elongated ovals with an estimated height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: A distinct downward elongation is visible, with the mass of the patch extending significantly below the eye toward the lateral muzzle.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are separated by a broad white cranial gap roughly equivalent to twice the horizontal width of an individual ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the ears exhibit a smooth, consistently convex semicircular curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: The ventral and abdominal fur displays a prominent yellowish-brown discoloration, contrasting with the high-reflectance white fur of the cranium.
